visualCharacteristics.purpose: Static rendering of a premium / subsidy calculator or tariff configurator: labelled fields (select, range, checkbox, date, value) with hints and an optional result table
visualCharacteristics.layout: Stacked fields; with a results row, inputs and results sit side by side on desktop

contentPattern.structure: one row per item. 1 cell = intro text or heading (or a result table). 2-3 cells = field: label | control | optional hint. Control cell: a list (optionally preceded by 'select'; bold item = selected) renders a select; 'checkbox' or '[ ]'/'[x]' a checkbox; 'range: <value>' a slider with the value; 'date' day/month/year inputs; 'input: <placeholder>' or 'search: <placeholder>' a text input; any other content is shown as a static value (e.g. '67 Jahre'). A row whose first cell is 'Results' (or 'Ergebnis') starts the results panel; its second cell is the panel heading

reuseGuidance: Use calculator for every premium, pension-subsidy, age, contribution and tariff-configurator widget. The block renders the authored fields, labels, options and result table statically: live calculation, quote services, profession lookup and form submission are out of scope for now and will need a later integration pass. Add an option class rather than a new block for colour or panel differences.
